newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips end softer, small-caps plummet.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips end softer, small-caps plummet.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip stocks ended marginally lower, as fund managers took an expected breather in their long-term buying activity, dealers and analysts said.
"There had been a run-up in blue-chips for the last three to four days, so we had expected some short-term easing," said a trader at a local bank-backed securities house.
The Composite Index of blue-chip stocks was down 0.56 points to 1,234.17, while the Second Board index dropped 22.54 points to 594.22.
